# create_agent_tool

> Create an LLM agent from JSON config with prompts, tools, resources, and roles.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=create_agent_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Create an LLM agent from JSON config with prompts, tools, resources, and roles.

WORKFLOW: 1) list_available_llm_models_tool 2) list_available_prompts_tool 3) list_available_agent_tools_tool 4) This tool

REQUIRED: name (1-128 chars), description, llm_model: {internal_identifier: "model-id"}

OPTIONAL FIELDS:
- schedule: cron expression (null for manual-only)
- active: false (default), set true to activate immediately
- discoverable_by_other_agents: false (default)
- llm_system_prompt: agent personality/behavior (string)
- llm_user_prompt: task instructions (string)
- roles: ["software_engineer", "analyst"] (role internal_identifiers from RoleType — persona/job role, not permissions)
- security_role_iids: ["agent_task_management"] (SecurityRole internal_identifiers to grant, in ADDITION to the
  `basic` + `agent_runtime` every agent gets automatically. Pass "agent_task_management" for an agent that
  needs to view/create/update StatusApplications — e.g. one that moves board cards — or it will 403 with
  "Invalid Access to view StatusApplications" on its first run.)
- internal_tool_use_list: ["general_crud_tool", "model_schema_tool"] (system tools)
- internal_resource_use_list: [] (system resources)
- tool_configurations: {"tool_name": {config_key: "value"}}

CUSTOM TOOLS (llm_tools array): {name, description, input_schema (JSON string), call_block (JS code), active: true}
CUSTOM RESOURCES (llm_resources array): {name, description, is_content: true/false, content (if is_content), call_block (if !is_content)}

EXAMPLE:
{
  "name": "my_agent",
  "description": "Agent description",
  "llm_model": {"internal_identifier": "gpt-4"},
  "llm_system_prompt": "You are a helpful assistant.",
  "roles": ["software_engineer"],
  "internal_tool_use_list": ["general_crud_tool"]
}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_data` | object | yes | Agent configuration in JSON import format with complete structure as documented above. |

```json
  "properties": {

      "type": "object",
      "description": "Agent configuration in JSON import format with complete structure as documented above"
    }
  },

  ]
}
```
